rules: Counted, never estimated. Every entry cites the paper ids and question ids it counted.
The research accounting identity must hold for the paper set: expected = processed + inaccessible + irrelevant + duplicate + failed.
Partial coverage is reported as a fraction (for example 120 / 250) and marked PARTIAL. It is never rounded up to a claim about the whole set.
Evidence of past behaviour is not a rule about future papers. A pattern observed across papers must never be relabelled T1_OFFICIAL.
